issues.summary: Guard reads flag per request instead of caching in constructor
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: src/modules/safe-shield/guards/copilot-core-gating.guard.ts:15-17 resolves `features.copilotCoreDisabled` once in the constructor into `this.disabled`; canActivate only reads the field.

issues.summary: No dedicated unit test for CopilotCoreGatingGuard
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: src/modules/safe-shield/guards/copilot-core-gating.guard.spec.ts:13-19 tests both the flag-on case (throws CopilotCoreDisabledError) and the flag-off case (returns true).

issues.summary: New safe-shield guard/error/filter live in non-canonical root-level guards/ and errors/ folders
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: The files sit at src/modules/safe-shield/guards/ and errors/. module-structure.md:79 names `routes/guards/` as the home for a guard, and the entitlements error/filter in this PR use domain/errors and domain/exception-filters. The PR description even claims `routes/guards/`. Consistency and maintainability cost only.

issues.summary: Comments claim SafeShieldService lives in `routes/`, but it's at the module root
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: src/modules/safe-shield/safe-shield.service.ts:50-51 and domain/safe-shield-analysis.interface.ts:14 refer to `routes/`, yet no src/modules/safe-shield/routes directory exists. Documentation mismatch.

issues.summary: Error message and doc comments say counterparty analysis is gated on Core, but only recipient-check is
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: copilot-core-disabled.error.ts:6,13 and copilot-core-gating.guard.ts:6 say 'recipient/counterparty'. safe-shield.controller.ts applies the guard only to analyzeRecipient, so the 402 message clients receive overstates the restriction.

issues.summary: New feature flag comment names a removal condition but no owner
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: configuration.ts:495 says only 'Disables Core's recipient-check. Remove once no client calls it.' configuration-and-flags.md:51,57 requires new flags to carry an owner and a condition, as mfaStepUp does.

issues.summary: Spaces controller imports safe-shield DTOs/schemas from its entities/, not domain/
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: space-safe-shield.controller.ts:28-31 imports from `@/modules/safe-shield/entities/...`. Non-negotiable #4 limits cross-module imports to `domain/`, so the Spaces API contract is coupled to safe-shield's endpoint DTOs.

issues.summary: Space-scoped safe-shield controller placed in Spaces rather than the owning module
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: space-relay, space-counterfactual-safes and entitlements controllers declare `spaces/:spaceId/...` routes in their owning modules, while this PR puts SpaceSafeShieldController in src/modules/spaces/routes/safe-shield/. This is an inconsistent placement choice; behaviour is unaffected.

issues.summary: SafeShieldService still exported despite having no external consumer
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: safe-shield.module.ts:33 exports SafeShieldService alongside the token. Grep finds no import of SafeShieldService outside safe-shield, and the new comment says it is 'never imported directly'.

issues.summary: assertFeatureGranted accepts any FeatureKey and only checks `enabled`
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: entitlement-enforcement.interface.ts:38-41 types featureKey as FeatureKey, and entitlements.service.ts:195-196 checks only grant.enabled. A future caller passing a metered key would bypass quota. The only current caller uses 'copilot_scans', so this is a latent risk.

issues.summary: Transaction shape typed inline and duplicated rather than reusing a shared type
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: The {to,value,data,operation} shape is written out in safe-shield-analysis.interface.ts:27-32 and again in space-safe-shield.service.ts:51-56. A TransactionBaseSchema exists in src/domain/common/schemas. Minor duplication.

issues.summary: appliedNames test helper duplicates filterNames in another spec
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: safe-shield.controller.spec.ts:45 appliedNames and space-safes.controller.spec.ts:8 filterNames do the same metadata lookup. This is minor test-helper duplication.

issues.evidence: All three specs alias addSafes/createSpaceForSigner to *Fixture, and none defines a local function with the original name. The aliases are redundant but harmless.

issues.evidence: space-safe-shield.service.spec.ts:114,173 say 'within quota', and the integration spec at :138,294 says 'plan/quota state', but copilot_scans is gated through assertFeatureGranted. Only the wording is off.

issues.evidence: space-safe-shield.service.spec.ts:116,174 cast partial objects, although src/modules/safe-shield/entities/__tests__/builders/analysis-responses.builder.ts exists. This is a style issue in test code.
